adminDesignLanguage.title: Panel design language
adminDesignLanguage.description: Shared premium hero and card grammar across admin, dealer, and customer dashboards — one component set and theme tokens.

hero.title: Page hero
hero.body: Use DashboardPageHero or Chrome; default tone=auto. Keep the eyebrow short; do not stack extra gradient ribbons on top of the shell.

surfaces.title: Cards & surfaces
surfaces.body: Prefer Card + border-border + bg-card; use primary accents instead of ad-hoc hex stripes, aligned with lib/panel-surface summary cards.

avoid.title: What we avoid
avoid.body: Different hero CSS per role, permanent off-token palettes, and duplicate “premium” frame layers.

status.title: Rollout
status.body: New screens align to this summary; older screens migrate over time. Changelog lives in DESIGN-LANGUAGE.md.

adminDesignLanguage.repoBody: Full prose and examples live in-repo.

adminAccessibility.title: WCAG-focused checklist
adminAccessibility.description: Perceivable–Operable–Understandable–Robust checks before shipping, plus external references.
adminAccessibility.intro: This page is not a legal audit; it reminds the team to run manual and automated checks during development.

perceivable.title: Perceivable
perceivable.hint: Contrast, text alternatives, readable typography; color alone must not carry meaning.

operable.title: Operable
operable.hint: Full keyboard navigation, visible focus rings, motion-reduce, and touch target sizing.

understandable.title: Understandable
understandable.hint: Form errors and language; consistent navigation labels.

robust.title: Robust
robust.hint: Semantic HTML, ARIA only when needed, stable roles in dynamic DOM.

adminAccessibility.linksHint: WCAG 2.2 quick reference, MDN, and axe rule sets.

adminObservability.cwvSectionHint: Google’s recommended thresholds; wire real-user data via RUM (e.g. web-vitals + analytics) or your host’s tooling.

adminObservability.rumSectionHint: Latest samples from admin, dealer, customer, and staff dashboards; in-memory per server instance.
adminObservability.rumEmpty: No samples yet. Browse any authenticated panel; metrics appear within a few seconds.
adminObservability.heroDescription: Vercel platform status, app health, and last-60-seconds traffic. Data refreshes automatically.

dealerAiInsights.heroSubtitle: Your feedback is analyzed by our AI engine—strengths, gaps, and prioritized actions in one place.
dealerAiInsights.methodologyStep1Body: Feedback from your QR codes (rating, text, date) is collected.
dealerAiInsights.methodologyStep2Body: Each feedback is analyzed for sentiment, intent (complaint/praise/suggestion), urgency, churn risk, and themes.
dealerAiInsights.methodologyStep3Body: Similar topics are grouped with machine learning; strong and weak themes are detected.
dealerAiInsights.methodologyStep4Body: All signals feed the model; causal factors, prioritized recommendations, and trends are merged into one report.
